display.purpose: Event titles only (create headline, featured list, detail hero). Not landing, nav, dashboard, or insights.

title.purpose: Smaller section and card titles. Manrope 24px / 700.

label.purpose: Buttons, nav, chips, field labels. Manrope 14px / 700.

shadows.name: none-chrome
shadows.purpose: Cards, inputs, buttons, nav, page. Flat by default.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Floating menus, popovers, date pickers, map overlays only. Opaque plate + 1px seam still required.

motion.name: none-hover
motion.purpose: Buttons do not ease or lift. Hover is brightness; active is a 2px press.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one filled action. Click Violet, 44px, 8px corners, 2px press.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; height: 44px; padding: 10px 16px; background: var(--color-primary, #7C3AED); color: var(--color-on-primary, #fff); font-family: Manrope, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: none; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(0.92); } .ds-btn-primary:active { filter: brightness(0.9); transform: translate(2px, 2px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--color-primary, #7C3AED); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Plate + 1px seam. Same press as primary. Not a second hue.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; height: 44px; padding: 10px 16px; background: var(--color-surface, #fff); color: var(--color-on-surface, #1A1C1C); font-family: Manrope, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; border: 1px solid var(--color-border-hard, #CCC3D8); border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: none; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--color-surface-container-low, #F3F3F4); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translate(2px, 2px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--color-primary, #7C3AED); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: 16px field radius, 44px min height, 1px seam, 2px primary focus ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; width: 100%; font-family: Manrope, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-on-surface, #1A1C1C); } .ds-input { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 12px; background: var(--color-surface, #fff); color: var(--color-on-surface, #1A1C1C); border: 1px solid var(--color-border-hard, #CCC3D8); border-radius: 16px; font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; font-family: inherit; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-on-surface-variant, #4A4455); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; } .ds-input:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--color-primary, #7C3AED); }

components.name: Chip
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.25rem; padding: 4px 12px; background: var(--color-on-primary-container, #5B21B6); color: var(--color-primary, #7C3AED); font-family: Manrope, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 20px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border-hard, #CCC3D8); border-radius: 9999px; } .ds-chip:hover { filter: brightness(1.05); }

narrative.overview:
Click Web is a neo-brutal desk, not a social atmosphere. Every chrome surface is an opaque plate. Seams are 1px outline-variant lines you can count. Depth is a stack of grey-violet tones, never blur, glass, or drop shadow on product chrome. One violet switch does all interactive work: CTAs, active nav, text links, map pins, selected pills, focus rings.

The system is de-AI-ified on purpose. It refuses ethereal gradients, synthetic glows, neon text-shadow, and dual-accent palettes. Personality lives in weight and structure: heavy Manrope, modular bordered panels, a 2px press nudge on buttons. The only sanctioned non-flat paint is entity identity — beacons, event covers, capsules — generated from the entity id so the same thing looks the same on map, list, and phone.

Light is the default room. Dark is the same room at night: purple-black walls, still opaque, still one switch. Marketing, dashboard, events, and insights share one page column and one navbar language so the companion never splits into a “pretty site” and an “app.”
keyCharacteristics: Quiet 1px seams; 2px reserved for focus and the button press
Manrope for all UI; Source Serif 4 only on event titles
Shared max-w-6xl page column with the navbar

rules.name: The One Switch Rule
rules.body: Click Violet is the only interactive hue. If a control, link, pin, or selected state is not violet, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Chrome Is Not the Content Rule
rules.body: Gradients, patterns, and hue families belong on generated entity surfaces. Chrome stays flat color + 1px seam.

rules.name: The Event Serif Rule
rules.body: Source Serif 4 appears only on event titles. Everywhere else is Manrope, including the marketing hero.

rules.name: The Weight Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: There is one family for UI. Size and weight do the ranking. Do not add a second sans.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. A shadow means the object is floating above the desk (a menu), not that the card is fancy.

dos: Do use bg-background, bg-surface, text-on-surface, border-border-hard, text-primary / bg-primary (or var(--color-primary)).
Do build with FcCard, FcButton, FcInput, FcTextarea, FcChip, FcPageShell, FcSectionHeader.
Do keep one page column (PAGE_COLUMN_CLASS) shared with the navbar.
Do route entity paint through CardVisualHero / cardVisualStyle, seeded with the raw id.
Do ship WCAG 2.2 AA: 14px floor, 4.5:1 on generated scrims and chrome text, visible 2px focus rings, 44px primary controls.
donts: Don't reintroduce glass, backdrop-blur, neon glow, gradient text, or gradient borders on chrome.
Don't add a second interactive accent (legacy blue #224cff / #3A86FF, extra purples #8338EC / #630ed4 on chrome).
Don't put Source Serif on landing, nav, dashboard, or insights.
Don't drop shadows on cards to “add depth.”
Don't invent a per-component entity gradient or seed with a list-key prefix.
Don't hardcode zinc-950 / #121212 page chrome (call overlay #101212 is the listed exception).
Don't fork this web border/accent language back onto mobile Compose’s 2px brutal frames.
